findings.title: Journal entries multiply a plant's harvest count and harvest weight
findings.where: GET /api/plants/{id}, /plants list and plant detail page
findings.expected: A plant with 2 harvests (100 g + 200 g) and 3 journal entries shows 2 harvests and 300 g
findings.actual: API returns harvest_count 6 and harvest_grams 900; the plants list card shows 900 g and the detail page shows '900 g total, 6 harvests' while listing only 2 harvest rows. The new LEFT JOIN on journal_entries in PLANT_SELECT multiplies the harvest rows that COUNT(h.id) and SUM(h.weight_grams) add up

findings.title: Harvest count on plant detail page inflated by journal entries
